title: 大型上市一来：配置需求先冻住，节奏该不该拉开？
speaker: Unknown (Citi Global Co-Head of Equity Capital Markets)

segments.en: I guess just the follow-on-evans question there and I think what's happened in especially in Hong Kong is it seems and it could be wrong. It seems that the robust pipeline of IPO's has somewhat come at a cost of the other parts of the market.
segments.zh: 我想接着问一个后续问题，尤其是在香港发生的情况，看起来——也可能是错的。看起来强劲的IPO排队在某种程度上以市场其他部分为代价。

segments.en: And is there enough liquidity? And when we get this big listing, it seems that people are frozen in terms of what they need to allocate and then that does come at the cost of the benchmark.
segments.zh: 流动性是否充足？当大型上市来临时，人们似乎在配置需求上陷入停滞，这确实以基准为代价。

segments.en: Is there a sense that there's too many that there needs to be a conversation around spacing? Some of these big listings, how would you as an underwriter approaching?
segments.zh: 是否感觉数量太多，需要围绕节奏安排进行讨论？其中一些大型上市，您作为承销商会如何应对？

segments.en: Yeah, I think that's a lot of the conversation. I think it's an interesting question. In our view, I think when you think about it long-term,
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这是很多讨论的焦点。这是个有趣的问题。在我们看来，从长期角度思考，

segments.en: adding high quality companies across different sectors into an index and into a market from a listed basis is long-term healthy period.
segments.zh: 将不同板块的高质量公司以上市方式纳入指数和市场，长期来看是健康的。

segments.en: So you might have a period where initially there's a lot of issuance happening and that sort of has a sideways effect on the rest of the market.
segments.zh: 因此，初期可能会有大量发行发生，这对市场其他部分产生横盘效应。

segments.en: But I do think that we need to look at it from the lens of a six month, 12 month, two year, three year period in terms of what it adds to that market to have these exciting listed companies in place as opposed to just the immediate term.
segments.zh: 但我确实认为，我们需要从六个月、12个月、两年、三年的角度，来看待这些令人兴奋的上市公司为市场增添了什麼，而非仅看眼前。

segments.en: So does the pipeline need to be slightly spaced? I think the answer probably would be yes and people need to find the right windows to come out and do their transactions, but I do think this is for the long-term health of the market.
segments.zh: 那么，IPO排队是否需要稍微拉开节奏？我认为答案可能是肯定的，人们需要找到合适的窗口来发行和交易，但我确实认为这是为了市场的长期健康。
